blocks.content: Quiz: When a component receives props, how are they structured inside the component?
Tap an option below to answer:
As separate variables automatically created for each attribute
React does not automatically create individual variables. All attributes are grouped together.
React does not automatically create individual variables. All attributes are grouped together.
As a single object containing key–value pairs
React collects all passed attributes into one object, where each attribute name becomes a key and its value becomes the corresponding value.
React collects all passed attributes into one object, where each attribute name becomes a key and its value becomes the corresponding value.
As an array of values in the order they were written
Props are accessed by name (keys), not by position, so they are not stored in an array.
Props are accessed by name (keys), not by position, so they are not stored in an array.
As a string that must be parsed
Props are passed as structured data, not as a raw string that needs manual parsing.
Props are passed as structured data, not as a raw string that needs manual parsing.
